newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong democrats ask China's Qian for parley.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong democrats ask China's Qian for parley.

text.p: Hong Kong's largest political party, the Democratic Party, said on Friday they had sent a letter to Chinese Foreign Minister Qian Qichen asking for a meeting during his visit to the British colony on November 15.
"We have sent a letter to Mr Qian asking him for a meeting when he is in Hong Kong," party vice-chairman Szeto Wah told reporters.
"We would like to have a face-to-face discussion with him on matters concerning the handover," he said.
Hong Kong will return to Chinese rule at midnight on June 30 next year, ending a century and a half of British colonial rule.

The Democratic Party, a vocal critic of Chinese policy, has been branded as "subversive" by China. It has been sidelined by Beijing from the power structures that China is crafting to run the territory after the handover.
